decoded.meaning: SETTINGS{ NAME "app" SETTINGS{ NAME "kp" VALUE u32=7 } } — the `:settings` container after RFC-0022 §4: the shape is KEPT, the knobs are gone (§5.5)
decoded.note: a vertex that declares NO app fields reads the empty container `0B 40 00 00` instead; the reserved `app` subkey and the single-traversal renderer contract of RFC-0010 §A.4 both survive
